description: Dutch rent points (WWS, independent homes) and the maximum legal basic rent, as on our rent points calculator: total, sector, maximum rent and points per category. Every input is optional; defaults are the page example. Example: rooms=[{area_m2:24},{area_m2:11}].

build_year.description: Build year, when energy_source is "year" (no valid label)

cooling_rooms.description: Rooms with fixed cooling that also heats: 0, 1 or 2 (2 or more)

energy_label.description: Energy label A++++ to G (default C)

energy_source.description: label (default), ei (energy index) or year (no valid label: build year)

home_type.description: apartment (homes above or below it, default) or house (single-family)

kitchen_appliances.description: Built-in kitchen extras present. Default: extractor_hood, fridge, electric_oven, single_lever_tap.

kitchen_countertop.description: Countertop length incl. sink and hob: under_1m, 1_to_2m or 2m_or_more (default)

newly_built_after_july_2024.description: First lived in after 1 July 2024, construction started before 2028 (default false)

other_spaces.description: Other spaces (storage, attic, utility room) with area in m2; heated defaults to false. Default: one 4 m2 storage.

private_outdoor_m2.description: Private outdoor space in m2: garden, balcony, roof terrace (default 0)

rooms.description: Rooms (living room, bedrooms, kitchen, bathroom...) with their floor area in m2; heated defaults to true. Default: the page example 24, 11, 7 and 4 m2.

toilets_separate_room.description: Toilets in a separate toilet room (default 1)

name: rent_points
title: Dutch rent points calculator (WWS)
